name: Mitsuaki
source:
Rikka's childhood friend who has returned to the Beyondaris household as a butler. He has been a serious person since his youth and always uses honorifics to everyone. He is also good at housework, studying, and martial arts.

[Translated from [url=http://magichouse.uh-oh.jp/05blind_3.html]official website[/url]]
